Highest-traffic fix — hits every write in the product.\n\n```python\nasync def _get_tenant_cached(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID) -> Tenant | None:\n    redis = get_redis()\n    cached = await redis.get(f\"tenant:gate:{tenant_id}\")\n    if cached is not None:\n        return Tenant(**json.loads(cached))\n    tenant = await session.get(Tenant, tenant_id)\n    if tenant is not None:\n        await redis.set(\n            f\"tenant:gate:{tenant_id}\",\n            json.dumps({\"id\": str(tenant.id), \"subscription_status\": tenant.subscription_status,\n                        \"is_demo\": tenant.is_demo,\n                        \"demo_expires_at\": tenant.demo_expires_at.isoformat() if tenant.demo_expires_at else None}),\n            ex=20,\n        )\n    return tenant\n```\nUse in both call sites.
